method: tools/native_probe/camera_sweep.py: in-process pad (stick range +-32767; 32000 = full, 16000 = half), 50 ms memory poll of the ACUPlayerCameraComponent owned by the player (CameraManager [0x14521AAD0] +0x40 array; component +0x50 position, +0x60 quaternion)

conventions.yaw: compass degrees atan2(fx, fy) of forward = q applied to local +Y; 0 = +Y, 90 = +X
conventions.units: world units as stored (metres per ACU-RE-0047)

not_established: right-stick response curve between half and full deflection (two points only)
camera collision and distance policy (distance varies 1.2-3.9 m with pitch and walls)
auto-recentre rules (pitch returns to about -3.3 deg on movement; yaw follows a strafing player)
dependence on frame rate (only a 30 fps cap measured)
